registered_requirements_cross_check.assessment: The explicit 1.8 order gate applies to spatial N refinement. The physical temporal protocol requires the stated same-grid reference and separate B/A/phi error/order reporting, without a numeric temporal-order gate. This is checked against the plans and inherited M0 contract, not inferred from the production runner. Failed/nonmonotone/sublinear physical behavior remains reported; second-order physical time accuracy is not established.

input_provenance_note: Report retains exact frozen source and binary hashes and raw hashes for every completed temporal run, plus canonical inspected run-record hashes. Observed containing metadata hashes record exact bytes inspected; growing global packets are not certified complete.

limitations.reference: Same N64 fixed grid and initial state, dt cap 2.5e-5; this reference is finite, not the exact semi-discrete solution.
limitations.order: Adjacent L1 cap-ratio slopes only, no prospective physical temporal accuracy gate exists. Preserve negative/noise-dominated values without claiming physical accuracy orders.
limitations.gauge: A components are total A in each profile gauge; phi is cleaning scalar. They are reported separately from physical B. Profiles are compared only to references in their own gauge.
limitations.frozen_C1: Frozen initial div(A) and sound speed retained in endpoint cleaning stage; this packet does not replace the independent gauge-mode test or establish general second-order time accuracy.
limitations.time_history: Only aggregate accepted min/max/step counts, rejection counts, root sequence and output-time diagnostics are available. Clock-model agreement is not a recorded full per-step dt trace.

finite_reference_linear_error_example.assumption: If the leading same-grid error is C*dt with fixed C, subtraction of a nonzero dt_ref gives these apparent slopes; this is an illustration, not a fitted mechanism proof.

limitations.roundoff_components: Regular travelling bx in both profiles is about 1.5e-16; regular standing signal bx is about 2e-15. Their recorded positive/negative slopes are roundoff diagnostics, not accuracy orders.

finding: No integrity, configuration or reference-pairing defect found. Original regular standing B reference differences are nonmonotone; all temporal slopes and component roundoff behavior are retained. Second-order physical time accuracy is not demonstrated. No numeric temporal-order acceptance gate is invented.
